title: mixcore core API (demo mixer): result of StartDemo
description: Where the demo mixer listens. Pass family, host and port to Start (config.schema.json) unchanged. host is always the IPv4 loopback address: the demo mixer and the session to it never send to another address. name is what the simulated console reports (snapshot console.name); a UI shows its own localized Demo label instead of it.

port.description: Chosen by the OS at StartDemo; differs between runs.
